overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on positional encoding methods for Transformers, with experiments on both NLU tasks (classification via GLUE/XTREME) and NLG tasks (machine translation via WMT18). While Question Answering and Classification are mentioned, these are understanding tasks, so only Machine Translation qualifies as an NLG task. The paper uses BLEU scores for MT evaluation but contains no human evaluation or LLM-as-judge assessment.
